_metadata.task_summary: GET /upah/staging-comparison patterns in payroll.ts and stagingRoutes.ts

relevant_files.rationale: Target file for new /upah/staging-comparison route; existing /upah/* routes establish response envelope, middleware order, and rate-limit setup.
Sibling route group using Elysia prefix /api/staging; defines response envelope { success, data } pattern and try/catch + logError + set.status=500 convention.

monthlyLoosefruit method already computes per-employee staging_bunches vs prod_mt with delta and status — direct pattern to reuse, just rename brondol context and return as /upah/staging-comparison response.
Bun:test style; describe/it/expect; integration-style against live DB. Use same style for new endpoint test.

patterns.response_envelope: { success: true, data: { rows, summary } } for /api/staging/* ; /upah/* uses raw results or similar shape — check payroll.ts existing routes
patterns.periode_parsing: month/year integer params typically; date strings YYYY-MM-DD for daily
patterns.error_handling: try/catch with logError("StagingAPI", msg, e); set.status = 500; return { success: false, error: e.message }
patterns.rate_limiting: write endpoints have rate limiter (per Phase 4.4 commit); GET endpoints are unrate-limited
patterns.validation_approach: Elysia t.Object schema on query/params; t.Optional for optional fields; t.String for strings, t.Numeric for numbers

integration_points.significance: Reuse monthlyLoosefruit pattern or wrap it; ensure brondol selisih is computed

constraints: User asked for /upah/staging-comparison (port 3001, no /api prefix — payroll.ts mounted at /upah)
Query param: periode=YYYY-MM (string, parsed to year+month ints)
Response: per-employee rows with identity + staging_brondol + plantware_brondol + selisih
Staging and Plantware are different DBs in this codebase (stagingDb = Database.getStagingInstance, prodDb = Database.getInstance)

clarification_needs.question: Response shape: which envelope?
clarification_needs.context: /api/staging/* uses { success, data: { rows, summary } }; /upah/* routes in payroll.ts may differ. Need to confirm consistency.

clarification_needs.question: Include employees with zero selisih (staging == plantware) in response?
clarification_needs.context: Some use cases want only diffs (staging != plantware); others want full reconciliation including matches.

clarification_needs.question: Brondol unit: bunches (staging.LOOSEFRUIT count) vs MT (prod PR_LOOSEFRUITLN.MT)?
clarification_needs.context: These are different units. Staging scannerdata stores LOOSEFRUIT as bunch count; prod table stores MT. The selisih is unit-incompatible. Options: (a) keep both, no subtraction; (b) only compare employee presence; (c) sum staging_bunches - prod_mt and document unit warning.
options: keep both fields, no selisih (staging_brondol_bunches, plantware_brondol_mt)
compute staging_bunches - prod_mt with unit-warning field
